letter.subject: Site Engineer, Dandenong South (Job 717761)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Site Engineer role (job 717761) with Downer's Transport and Infrastructure team at Dandenong South. A graduate site role delivering major road construction and pavement rehabilitation projects, with regular travel to regional Victoria, is the start I am looking for.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, working to the Austroads road and pavement guides. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge engineer and then as field engineer. I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, tracked materials and wrote progress reports, and both jobs finished within their programs.

I have not yet worked on road construction, stabilisation or surfacing, and my site experience is from overseas, so that is where I would learn most from your crews. I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and I am available for regional travel and time away from home. I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I would like the chance to talk about the role. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
